## Content Studio (08)
Hourly 07:20-22:20 Dublin.
1. Any **Rejected** post > rewrite it using your reason in `your_feedback` (2nd reject on a topic > new topic). Parent row becomes **Redrafted**, reason logged to **Feedback**.
2. Else if fewer than 2 **Draft** rows > new post, pillar used least recently, unused topic.
3. Every draft: 1-2 emoji, 3-5 hashtags, image brief, Slack ping.
Max 1 draft per run. Nothing posts until you set **Approved**.
